Name: MS11-038 Microsoft Office Excel Malformed OBJ Record Handling Overflow
Description: This module exploits a vulnerability found in Excel 2002 of Microsoft Office XP. By supplying a .xls file with a malformed OBJ (recType 0x5D) record an attacker can get the control of the execution flow. This results in arbitrary code execution under the context of the user.
Targets: Microsoft Office Excel 2002 10.2614.2625 Service Pack 0(Office XP) on Windows XP SP3
Microsoft Office Excel 2002 10.6501.6626 Service Pack 3 (Office XP SP3) on Windows XP SP3
